newsitem.title: FRANCE: French chefs to receive Culture Ministry grants.
newsitem.headline: French chefs to receive Culture Ministry grants.

text.p: France's Culture Ministry is to award grants to talented young cooks and cash-strapped master chefs, a measure hailed by recipients as well-deserved recognition of their status as artists.

Ministry officials said on Thursday that grants of 100,000 francs ($20,000) would be awarded to three young chefs setting up restaurants, and other subsidies would be available to master chefs hit by economic difficulties.
"This is a big first," Christian Conticini of Paris eatery La Table d'Anvers told Le Figaro newspaper. "This proves that at last we go from the status of artisans to the profession of creator."
